description: Upload a new attachment to an issue/PR comment from exactly one of base64 content or a file path on the forgejo-mcp host.

content.description: Base64-encoded file bytes to upload, as a string. Provide exactly one of content or file_path. A non-string value, including null, is rejected (omit the argument instead)

file_path.description: Path to a file on the forgejo-mcp host, as a string. Relative paths resolve from the server process working directory. Disabled unless the host sets FORGEJO_MCP_ALLOW_FILE_PATH_UPLOAD=1, and confined to FORGEJO_MCP_UPLOAD_ROOT when that is set. Provide exactly one of content or file_path. A non-string value, including null, is rejected (omit the argument instead)

filename.description: Filename to associate with the upload. Required with content; optional with file_path (defaults to the path basename)

mime_type.description: MIME type hint for uploaded file (optional; inferred from filename if omitted)

name: create_comment_attachment
